name: run-stage-entry
description: The staging of one comparison entry, stageEntry of Tools/Gauntlet/Harness/run.mjs, and its Jet twin, the Stage module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/Gauntlet/Kit/Source/Stage.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver with a stand-in jet (Fixtures/fake-jet.txt) and the launcher built from Tools/Gauntlet/Harness/launch.c: a batch entry with Python and Node peers, a declared non-applicable rail, a missing source and an unsupported language, timed on its AOT, run (repeat, edited and fresh-install cache states) and dev tiers; the same entry on a --languages run that measures only Python, recording the Node row and Jet's tiers unmeasured; a batch-steps entry reset between its steps, with the dev tier unavailable; a generated fixture with the entry's default run count; an entry without expected output and one whose fixture generator is missing; a failed Jet build, a peer whose output differs and one that exits non-zero; a batch entry with a TCP peer started for each rail; a line service measured over its probes on each tier; at three runs, a line service that answers after 2 ms, so that no latency falls under a millisecond, with one fresh-process startup sample per run on each row; and a web entry with a configured Jet build, its dist/ assets and the node rail's module graph sized. Every measurement, and what follows from one, reads <measured>.
